Full one-skeleton and off-line triangles filling each missing collinear triple boundary give boundary_2 rank 66, so ker boundary_2 is dimension168. The 234x234 tetrahedral boundary has rank168 modulo 101 and 1009 independently; because boundary_2 boundary_3=0 gives rational upper bound168, modular minor gives exact rational rank168, hence H3 dim66 and no other rational reduced groups. Enumerating all 5616 scalar-normalized invertible 3x3 F3 matrices and signed Lefschetz traces produces exactly the character of wedge^2 U from (chi_U(g)^2-chi_U(g^2))/2 for each element. Character equality over Q is justified since finite-group rational characters identify Q-representations in this setting (rational representation character injectivity). Independent reconstruction reproduced 13/78/234/234, rank168 and 5616 character identities. This proves no integral action or integral torsion claims.
